name: 張烔堡
objective:
先修課程: 負責教授同意
物質熱力學特性，改變能量形式之基本原理，熱力學第一及第二定律，可逆性與可用性，動力循環，冷凍循環，混合氣，化學反應。
Thermodynamic Properties of Substance, Energy Forms, The First Law of Thermodynamics, The Second Law of Thermodynamics, Irreversibility & Availability, Power Cycle, Refrigeration Systems, Mixtures, Chemical Reactions.
schedule:
第 1 週: Thermodynamics and energy, dimension and units, closed and opened system, state and balance, process and cycle, types of the energy.
第 2-3 週: Pure material, phases of pure materials, phase varied process of pure material, property chart, ideal gas, specific heat, internal energy.
第 4-5 週: Heat transfer, energy transfer of the work, mechanical work, non- mechanical work, mass conservation law.
第 6-7 週: The first law of thermodynamics, the energy balance of closed system, the energy balance of opened system, some engineering devices of steady flow system.
第 8 週: The basic of second law, heat reservoir, heat engine
第 9 週：期中考
第 10 週: The energy transformation efficiency, refrigerator and heat pump, reversible and irreversible.
第 11-12 週: Entropy, entropy change of pure material, isotropic process, Mollier chart.
第 13-15 週: Basic consideration of the power cycle, Carnot cycle, Otto and Diesel cycle, Stirling and Ericsson cycle, Brayton cycle.
第 16 週: Refrigeration, heat pump, Steam compressed refrigeration cycle, refrigerant 
第 17 週: Heat pump system, dry air and atmosphere, specific humidity and relative humidity. 
第 18 週：期末考
scorePolicy:

期末成績 	40%	期末考
materials: 熱力學, 原著: Borgnakke Claus, 高立書局
consultation: office hour 時間歡迎至綜科館 113 諮詢
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG2：消除飢餓（Zero Hunger）SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG7：可負擔的潔淨能源（Affordable and Clean Energy）
